question: What quality characterizes the arising of this Illumination of the Eye?
premises: The Illumination of the Eye has arisen.
Its arising is marked by fullness.
That fullness is the nectar of supreme nonduality.
inference: This Netrodyota has arisen filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
plain_english: This Illumination of the Eye has arisen, filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
